messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout: MarinerTech (dedicated tenant) -> v1.12.3 on 2026-04-01 22:00 UTC. Change window 22:00-23:30 UTC. Canary 10% first, then 50%, then full. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/marinertech-rollout :rocket:
Emma R.: Ack, I'm the release owner for this release. Pinged SRE and Security for approvals. I put the checklist in the runbook.
Ryan S.: Looking at capacity, we have two spare slices in us-west for tonight's window. Canary circuit set to auto-fail to v1.11 if p95 latency > 450ms for 5m.
Priya K.: Model variant is redwood-small-quant, pinned to commit sha abc1234. We're also lifting KV cache warm-up 30m before.
Sana L.: Customer confirmed they can accept the window; they asked for audit logging to be captured and forwarded to their S3 bucket. I've shared the KMS key ARN.
Oliver M.: Security note: KMS rotation is scheduled 2026-04-01 21:30 UTC in the customer's account. That collides with our window. We need to be explicit about KMS key version used in the rollout. Recommend delaying rotation or moving our window 30m later.
Emma R.: Good catch. @Sana L. can you ask MarinerTech to postpone rotation to 23:30 UTC? If not, we shift to 22:30-00:00.
Sana L.: Chatted with them; they can postpone rotation to 23:45. They want us to start at 22:15 and be done with canary before 23:45. Is that feasible?
Ryan S.: 22:15 start compresses the plan but still doable if canary durations are tuned. We normally allow 10m stability checks per gate; we can reduce to 5m on canary if load and p95 look stable. Need oncall ack.
Katie O.: Oncall here. I can cover the compressed checks. I'll have the profiling dashboard open and scripted alerts ready.
Emma R.: Ok. New proposed window: 2026-04-01 22:15-23:45 UTC. Canary 10% for 5m, 50% for 10m, full roll for 20m, with automatic rollback triggers.
deploy-bot: Deploy command preview:
```
/deploy tenant marinertech --model redwood-small-quant --version 1.12.3 --commit abc1234 \
  --canary 10 --canary-duration 5m --gate p95<=450ms:5m \
  --next 50 --next-duration 10m --final 100 --final-duration 20m \
  --fallback-version 1.11.9 --audit-s3 s3://marinertech-audit-logs --kms-arn arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01
```
deploy-bot: Note: this will pin tenant to 1.12.3; rollback will pin back to fallback-version if triggered.
Priya K.: We must also pin model weights to the commit in the model registry; added a lock step in the runbook.
Oliver M.: Security approves provided the KMS rotation is postponed until 23:45 and the KMS ARN matches the one Sana sent. Also require we capture and ship CloudTrail snapshots for the window.
Sana L.: Confirmed rotation postponed to 23:45 and provided the ARN. Customer also asked for a pre-cutover demo of telemetry at 21:50 UTC.
Emma R.: Let's do a quick smoke at 21:55 then. @Ryan S. @Katie O. please be ready at 21:50 for the demo.
Ryan S.: I'll spin a lightweight canary load at 21:55 against a staging tenant to validate the telemetry pipeline and KV cache warmup script.
Katie O.: I'll prepare alert overrides and the incident channel (#release-marinertech) to be on standby.
Priya K.: One more note: quantized weights have a known rare case where output truncation can increase for inputs >2048 tokens. MarinerTech said most requests are <1024 tokens. Need to record this in release notes and in the canary observation checklist.
Emma R.: Added to release notes and to the canary checklist.
Sana L.: Customer accepted the notes. They've authorized the run-at 22:15-23:45 with KMS rotation at 23:45.
Oliver M.: Security: Marking approval in the runbook. Will request CloudTrail export immediately after the window.
Katie O.: Oncall acked. I'll be primary pager for the rollout. If anything looks bad, we'll hit manual rollback which pins to 1.11.9.
Emma R.: Final approvals: @Ryan S. (SRE) :thumbsup:, @Oliver M. (Security) :thumbsup:, @Katie O. (Oncall) :thumbsup:, @Sana L. (CS) :thumbsup:. If everyone confirms in thread, we'll execute.
Ryan S.: :thumbsup:
Oliver M.: :thumbsup:
Katie O.: :thumbsup:
Sana L.: :thumbsup:
Emma R.: Executing pre-rollout checklist now. I'll post a final 'starting' message 5m before 22:15 UTC.
deply-bot: (typo-sim): Oops, ignore me.
deploy-bot: (audit-bot) Runbook locked by release owner Emma R. at 2026-04-01T21:10:00Z.
Emma R.: Thanks everyone — see you in #release-marinertech at 22:10 for pre-flight.
Katie O.: I'll create the incident channel now and invite SRE, Eng, Security, and CS.
Sana L.: I'll coordinate with MarinerTech for final readiness and forward any late changes.
Emma R.: Thread closed for approvals. Start message will be at 22:10 UTC.
